alesha_cs: Quick draft for low-touch kickoff runbook — short checklist to hand customers that may have mobile-heavy usage and tight token budgets.

alesha_cs: TL;DR: 1) prefill 3 msgs, 2) prefer batching for mobile UX, 3) stream only for interactive flows, 4) set token soft-limits + alert 24h before renewal, 5) capture quick feedback 1h after go-live.

devin_se: this looks great. can we add a tiny code snippet customers can paste for a simple batch call? :thumbsup:

alesha_cs: yes, adding sample curl + client pseudocode below — small enough to include in the onboarding email.

alesha_cs: ```
# curl sample: lightweight batch request
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3.1-small","inputs":["msg1","msg2","msg3"],"max_tokens":150,"stream":false}'

# client pseudo (node):
await client.generate({model:'redwood-3.1-small', inputs:['msg1','msg2','msg3'], max_tokens:150, stream:false})
```

sam_sre: add a note to suggest a short TTL for cached prefixes and to enable per-tenant concurrency limit. mobile networks get bursty.

alesha_cs: yup — added: cache TTL = 30s for session prefixes; per-tenant concurrency = 3 by default. Also included fallback to stream when latency < 300ms and user engaged.

cory_pm: for renewals, add a flag 'renewal_risk=early' when avg token consumption > 85% of monthly quota for two consecutive weeks. That should help CS triage.

alesha_cs: good call. I'll wire that into our customer health dashboard alerts and add a suggested outreach script.

cory_pm: outreach script idea: "We noticed your usage is close to your monthly limit — can we help optimize prompts or enable burst capacity for busy days?" short and friendly.

ops_bot: reminder: created doc in Confluence -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/lite-onboard-runbook (permissions: customer-success, product)

devin_se: tiny nit: include explicit example of switching to streaming in the client snippet (one-liner). I'll add after lunch.

alesha_cs: perfect — if no objections I'll publish and attach to the low-touch kickoff template. pls drop final edits here by EOD. :wave:
